subject.title: fix #95295: [Bug]: Web UI sidebar hides existing child-spawned subagent sessions across agent scopes

question: Should the accepted fix for cross-agent child-session discoverability be this sidebar-only All agents toggle, or should it also include the Sessions table/shared visibility model?
rationale: The code path is narrow and preserves default scoping, but it adds a user-facing scope control and competes with a broader open candidate, so automation should not choose the permanent UX boundary alone.

options.title: Land sidebar-only after proof
options.body: Keep default scoped behavior and accept a sidebar-only All agents affordance once the contributor supplies verifiable rendered UI proof.

options.title: Require broader table parity
options.body: Use or rewrite toward the broader direction if cross-agent child sessions should also appear in the Sessions table All agents view.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Defer this PR if maintainers do not want another sidebar scope control in core UI.

recommendation.title: Land sidebar-only after proof
recommendation.body: Keep default scoped behavior and accept a sidebar-only All agents affordance once the contributor supplies verifiable rendered UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged sidebar architecture work makes this the best available routing owner for the UX scope choice.
